एक पल के लिए रुकें, फिर अपने धड़ को बाईं ओर मोड़ें, वजन या दवा की गेंद को अपनी बाईं ओर फर्श की ओर लाएं।
दोहराव की वांछित संख्या के लिए पक्षों को बदलना जारी रखें।

breathing.concentric: Exhale and squeeze abdomen at top

trainerTip: Focus on a controlled 2-second negative phase for maximum hypertrophy and joint longevity.

name: Weighted Seated Twist (On Stability Ball)
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell with both hands close to your chest.
Engage your core and slowly rotate your torso to one side, keeping your hips stable.
Pause for a moment at the end of the rotation, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat the rotation to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsHi: अपने पैरों को ज़मीन पर सपाट करके और अपने घुटनों को 90 डिग्री के कोण पर मोड़कर एक स्टेबिलिटी बॉल पर बैठें।
दोनों हाथों से अपनी छाती के पास वेट प्लेट या डम्बल पकड़ें।
अपने कोर को संलग्न करें और अपने कूल्हों को स्थिर रखते हुए धीरे-धीरे अपने धड़ को एक तरफ घुमाएँ।
घूर्णन के अंत में एक पल के लिए रुकें, फिर धीरे-धीरे प्रारंभिक स्थिति में लौट आएं।
दूसरी ओर भी घुमाएँ दोहराएँ।
दोहराव की वांछित संख्या के लिए पक्षों को बदलना जारी रखें।

breathing.concentric: Exhale and squeeze abdomen at top

trainerTip: Focus on a controlled 2-second negative phase for maximum hypertrophy and joint longevity.

name: Weighted Side Bend (On Stability Ball)
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet shoulder-width apart and flat on the ground.
Hold a weight in one hand and place your other hand on your hip.
Engage your core and slowly bend sideways towards the weighted side, keeping your back straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsHi: अपने पैरों को कंधे की चौड़ाई से अलग और जमीन पर सपाट रखकर एक स्टेबिलिटी बॉल पर बैठें।
एक हाथ में वजन पकड़ें और दूसरे हाथ को अपने कूल्हे पर रखें।
अपने कोर को संलग्न करें और अपनी पीठ को सीधा रखते हुए धीरे-धीरे भार वाले हिस्से की ओर झुकें।
नीचे एक पल के लिए रुकें, फिर धीरे-धीरे प्रारंभिक स्थिति में लौट आएं।
दोहराव की वांछित संख्या के लिए दोहराएं, फिर पक्ष बदलें।

breathing.concentric: Exhale and squeeze abdomen at top

trainerTip: Focus on a controlled 2-second negative phase for maximum hypertrophy and joint longevity.

name: Weighted Sissy Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing slightly outward.
Hold a weight in front of your chest with both hands, or place a barbell across your upper back.
Keeping your chest up and your core engaged, slowly lower your body down by bending at the knees and hips.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsHi: अपने पैरों को कंधे की चौड़ाई पर फैलाकर खड़े हो जाएं और आपके पैर की उंगलियां थोड़ी बाहर की ओर हों।
दोनों हाथों से अपनी छाती के सामने वजन पकड़ें, या अपनी ऊपरी पीठ पर एक बारबेल रखें।
अपनी छाती को ऊपर और अपने कोर को व्यस्त रखते हुए, घुटनों और कूल्हों पर झुकते हुए धीरे-धीरे अपने शरीर को नीचे लाएँ।
तब तक नीचे उतरना जारी रखें जब तक कि आपकी जांघें जमीन के समानांतर न हो जाएं या जितना नीचे आप आराम से जा सकें, उतना नीचे आ जाएं।
नीचे एक पल के लिए रुकें, फिर प्रारंभिक स्थिति में लौटने के लिए अपनी एड़ियों से धक्का दें।
दोहराव की वांछित संख्या के लिए दोहराएँ।

breathing.eccentric: Deep belly inhale and brace core on descent

trainerTip: Drive knees out in line with toes, keep chest tall, and push the floor away through mid-foot.

name: Weighted Standing Curl
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and exhale as you curl the weights up to shoulder level.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale as you slowly lower the weights back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsHi: अपने पैरों को कंधे की चौड़ाई पर फैलाकर खड़े हो जाएं और दोनों हाथों में डंबल पकड़ लें, हथेलियां आगे की ओर हों।
अपनी कोहनियों को अपने धड़ के पास रखें और वजन को कंधे के स्तर तक मोड़ते हुए सांस छोड़ें।
शीर्ष पर एक क्षण के लिए रुकें, फिर श्वास लेते हुए धीरे-धीरे वजन को वापस प्रारंभिक स्थिति में ले आएं।
दोहराव की वांछित संख्या के लिए दोहराएँ।

breathing.concentric: Exhale as you pull with your lats and arms

commonMistakes: Using momentum to swing the weight
trainerTip: Pin your elbows firmly to your ribcage and avoid hip swinging for strict bicep isolation.

name: Wide Grip Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your hands wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pull your body up towards the bar until your chin is above the bar.
Lower your body back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsHi: अपनी हथेलियों को आपसे दूर की ओर रखते हुए और अपने हाथों को कंधे की चौड़ाई से अधिक चौड़ा रखते हुए पुल-अप बार से लटकें।
अपने कोर को संलग्न करें और अपने कंधे के ब्लेड को एक साथ निचोड़ें।
अपने शरीर को बार की ओर ऊपर खींचें जब तक कि आपकी ठुड्डी बार के ऊपर न आ जाए।
नियंत्रण के साथ अपने शरीर को वापस प्रारंभिक स्थिति में लाएँ।
दोहराव की वांछित संख्या के लिए दोहराएँ।

breathing.concentric: Exhale as you pull with your lats and arms

trainerTip: Focus on a controlled 2-second negative phase for maximum hypertrophy and joint longevity.

name: Wrist Circles
instructions: Extend your arms straight out in front of you.
Make a fist with both hands.
Rotate your wrists in a circular motion, keeping your arms still.
Continue the wrist circles for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsHi: अपनी बाहों को अपने सामने सीधा फैलाएं।
दोनों हाथों से मुट्ठी बांध लें.
अपनी भुजाओं को स्थिर रखते हुए अपनी कलाइयों को गोलाकार गति में घुमाएँ।
दोहराव की वांछित संख्या के लिए कलाई के घेरे जारी रखें।
trainerTip: Focus on a controlled 2-second negative phase for maximum hypertrophy and joint longevity.

name: 45 Degree Hyperextension
instructions: Position yourself on the 45-degree hyperextension bench with ankles secured.
Cross arms over chest or place hands behind head.
Lower your upper body forward at the hips.
Stop when your upper body is just below parallel to the floor.
Lift your torso back up in line with your legs.
breathingCue: Exhale as you rise, inhale as you lower.
trainerTip: A lower back exercise on a 45-degree hyperextension bench that targets the spinal erectors and posterior chain.

name: 45-Degree Bicycle Twisting Crunch
instructions: Lie down with your hands behind your head and legs extended upwards at about a 45-degree angle.
Engage your core and lift your shoulders off the ground.
Twist your upper body, bringing your right elbow toward your left knee as you extend your right leg.
Return to the starting position and repeat to the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides in a controlled, twisting motion.
breathingCue: Exhale during the twist, inhale as you return to center.
trainerTip: A twisting crunch performed at a 45-degree angle to target the obliques and rectus abdominis.

name: All Fours Groin Stretch
instructions: Start on hands and knees (quadruped position).
Slide knees apart, keeping shins and feet in line with knees.
Lower hips toward the floor, maintaining a flat back.
Move hips back gently until you feel a stretch in the groin.
Hold the position and breathe deeply.
breathingCue: Breathe slowly and deeply throughout the stretch.
trainerTip: A floor stretch on hands and knees targeting the adductors and groin area.

name: Band Bent-Over Rear Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand on a resistance band, feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge forward at hips, keeping back flat.
Hold band with both hands, arms hanging down.
Raise arms out to sides until parallel with shoulders.
Lower arms back down with control.
breathingCue: Exhale during the raise, inhale during the lowering.
trainerTip: A rear shoulder and upper back exercise using a resistance band in a bent-over position.

name: Band Hip Abduction
instructions: Place a resistance band around your thighs or ankles.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Shift weight to one leg.
Lift the other leg laterally against band resistance.
Return leg to start; repeat on both sides.
breathingCue: Exhale as you lift leg, inhale as you return.
trainerTip: A lateral leg movement with a resistance band to activate and strengthen the hip abductor muscles.

name: Band Hip Adduction
instructions: Secure a resistance band to a sturdy anchor at ankle height.
Loop the other end around your working ankle.
Stand tall and hold onto a support if needed.
Bring your working leg across your body, adducting at the hip.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.
breathingCue: Exhale as you pull leg inward, inhale as you return.
trainerTip: A resistance band exercise that strengthens the inner thigh muscles through hip adduction.

name: Band One Arm Front Raise
instructions: Stand with one foot on the band for resistance.
Hold handle in one hand at thigh level, palm facing down.
Keep arm straight, raise it forward to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower arm back down slowly and repeat.
breathingCue: Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.
trainerTip: Isolation shoulder exercise raising one arm forward against band resistance to target the anterior deltoid.

name: Band One-Leg Kickback (Bent Position)
instructions: Anchor the band and loop it around your working ankle.
Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees bent.
Engage your core and extend one leg backward against band resistance.
Pause and squeeze the glute at the top.
Return to starting position and repeat for desired reps, then switch legs.
breathingCue: Exhale as you kick back, inhale as you bring the knee in.
trainerTip: A glute-focused kickback performed from a bent-over position using a resistance band for added intensity.

name: Band Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Stand on the middle of the band with feet hip-width apart and hold one end in each hand.
Raise your hands overhead and bend your elbows so your hands move behind your head.
Keep your upper arms close to your ears and brace your midsection.
Straighten your elbows to press the band overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly at the top, then bend your elbows slowly to return behind your head.
Repeat without letting your elbows flare wide.
breathingCue: Inhale as you lower your hands behind your head, and exhale as you straighten your elbows overhead.
commonMistakes: Elbows flare out to the sides
Lower back arches as the band goes overhead
Upper arms drift forward and backward
Only moving partway instead of fully extending
trainerTip: A standing band triceps exercise where you extend your elbows overhead while keeping your upper arms mostly fixed.

name: Band Prone Leg Curl
instructions: Anchor the band securely at ground level.
Lie face down with legs extended.
Loop the band around your ankle.
Flex your knee, bringing your heel toward your glutes.
Slowly return to the start; repeat and switch legs if desired.
breathingCue: Exhale as you curl, inhale as you lower.
trainerTip: A hamstring isolation exercise performed lying face down and flexing the knee using resistance from a band.

name: Band Resisted Decline Sit-Up
instructions: Attach a resistance band securely behind the decline bench.
Lie on the bench with your feet anchored, holding the band at the chest or behind the neck.
Engage your core and perform a sit-up, raising your torso towards your knees.
Control the movement back down to starting position.
Repeat for the desired repetitions.
breathingCue: Exhale as you sit up, inhale as you lower down.
trainerTip: A decline sit-up performed with band resistance to increase tension on the abdominals.

name: Band Seated Leg Extension
formCues: Do not lock knee at top
instructions: Sit upright on a sturdy chair with feet flat.
Anchor one end of a band behind the chair leg.
Loop the other end of the band around your ankle.
Raise your lower leg to extend the knee fully.
Lower the leg back down under control; repeat and switch legs.
breathingCue: Exhale as you extend, inhale as you return.
commonMistakes: Allowing the knee to drift or twist
trainerTip: A seated exercise using a resistance band to isolate and strengthen the quadriceps.

name: Band Seated Row
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs straight and loop the band over your feet.
Grab the band handles or ends with both hands, arms extended.
Keep back straight and chest up.
Pull the handles back, driving elbows past your torso and squeezing shoulder blades.
Release slowly to the starting position.
breathingCue: Exhale as you row, inhale as you return to start.
trainerTip: Seated row using resistance bands that targets the mid-back and lats.

name: Band Shoulder Warm-Up Stretch
instructions: Stand tall and grip band with hands wider than shoulders.
Hold arms straight, band in front of thighs.
Slowly raise band overhead while keeping arms straight.
Move band behind head and down to lower back.
Reverse the movement to bring band to starting position.
breathingCue: Breathe naturally throughout stretch.
trainerTip: A shoulder stretch and mobility drill using a resistance band to warm up the deltoids and rotator cuff.

name: Band Side Bend
instructions: Anchor the resistance band securely at ground level.
Stand beside the anchor point, feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band handle with the outside hand, arm extended alongside your body.
Keeping your torso straight, bend sideways at the waist away from the anchor.
Return to the starting position and repeat for reps, then switch sides.
breathingCue: Exhale while bending, inhale on the return.
commonMistakes: Rotating the torso instead of bending laterally
trainerTip: A standing lateral bend using a resistance band to target and strengthen the oblique muscles.

name: Band Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width on the band.
Hold band handles by sides or at shoulders for resistance.
Keep torso upright and brace core.
Raise heels to stand on the balls of your feet, contracting calves.
Lower heels back to the floor slowly.
breathingCue: Exhale as you rise, inhale as you lower.
trainerTip: Standing calf raise performed with a resistance band to strengthen the calves.

name: Band Standing Leg Curl
instructions: Anchor the resistance band behind you at ground level.
Loop the band around one ankle.
Stand on the opposite leg and balance.
Curl your heel toward your glutes by flexing your knee.
Lower leg slowly; repeat and switch sides.
breathingCue: Exhale as you curl, inhale as you return.
trainerTip: A standing hamstring curl variation using resistance from a band for leg flexion.

name: Band Standing Lift
instructions: Anchor the band low near the floor.
Stand side-on to the anchor, feet shoulder-width.
Hold the band handle with both hands at hip level.
Lift and rotate your torso diagonally to the opposite side and above shoulder.
Return to start; repeat, then switch sides.
breathingCue: Exhale as you lift/rotate, inhale as you return.
trainerTip: A diagonal band movement to train the obliques and core stabilizers.

name: Band Straight-Back Seated Row
instructions: Sit on the floor and extend your legs forward.
Loop the band around your feet securely.
Grip the band handles with both hands, arms extended.
Keeping your back straight, pull the handles toward your waist, elbows close to your body.
Pause, squeeze your shoulder blades, then slowly return to the starting position.
breathingCue: Exhale as you row, inhale as you return to start.
commonMistakes: Using momentum rather than back muscles
trainerTip: A banded rowing movement emphasizing the upper back and lats while seated with a straight torso.

name: Band Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Anchor the band overhead and stand facing it with a handle or end in each hand.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees and pin your upper arms close to your sides.
Brace your torso and press your hands straight down until your elbows fully extend.
Pause briefly at the bottom and squeeze your triceps.
Slowly let the band rise back up until your forearms return to the start position.
Repeat without letting your elbows drift forward or outward.
breathingCue: Exhale as you press the band down, and inhale as you return to the start.
commonMistakes: Upper arms swinging forward and back
Elbows flaring away from the torso
Leaning body weight onto the band
Stopping short of full elbow extension
trainerTip: An isolation triceps exercise using an overhead-anchored band to straighten the elbows against resistance.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Position barbell on upper traps, unrack.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Descend into squat keeping back neutral.
Lower until thighs parallel or below.
Drive up through heels to standing.
breathingCue: Inhale lowering, exhale rising.
trainerTip: Classic compound lower body lift with barbell across traps, targeting quads and glutes.

name: Barbell Seated Behind-The-Neck Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support; grip barbell wider than shoulders.
Unrack barbell and hold above your head.
Lower barbell behind your head to just below ear level.
Press barbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for desired reps, keeping core engaged.
breathingCue: Exhale when pressing up, inhale when lowering the bar.
trainerTip: A shoulder press variation performed seated with a barbell lowered behind the neck to target the deltoids.

name: Barbell Underhand Bent-Over Row
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, barbell on floor.
Bend forward from hips, back straight, grasp bar underhand.
Let bar hang at arm’s length below shoulders.
Row barbell to torso, elbows close to sides.
Lower barbell under control to starting position.
breathingCue: Exhale as you row up, inhale as you lower down.
trainerTip: Row performed bent over with barbell and an underhand (supinated) grip, targeting lats and biceps.

name: Bench Crunch
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with knees bent and feet secured or flat.
Cross your arms over your chest or place hands behind your head.
Engage your core and lift your shoulders towards your knees.
Squeeze at the top and hold briefly.
Lower your upper body back to bench in a controlled manner.
breathingCue: Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.
trainerTip: An abdominal crunch performed lying on a flat or decline bench to isolate the abs.

name: Bench Dips
instructions: Sit on a bench and place your hands beside your hips, gripping the edge.
Extend your legs out in front with heels on the floor.
Slide your hips off the bench, supporting your weight with your arms.
Lower your body by bending your elbows to about 90 degrees.
Push through your palms to extend your elbows and return to the start.
breathingCue: Inhale as you lower down, exhale as you press upward.
trainerTip: Bench dips are a bodyweight exercise targeting the triceps by lowering and raising the body using a bench for support.

name: Bench Pull-Up
formCues: Don't let legs push too much
instructions: Place a bench under a pull-up bar.
Grip the bar with hands wider than shoulder-width.
Position feet on the bench for support.
Pull your chest towards the bar, using feet as needed.
Lower yourself slowly to starting position.
breathingCue: Exhale as you pull up, inhale as you lower down.
trainerTip: A pull-up variation using a bench for foot support to reduce load and assist the movement.

name: Bent Knee Lying Twist on Stability Ball
instructions: Lie on your back with calves on a stability ball.
Extend arms out at your sides for support.
Bend knees at 90 degrees over the ball.
Slowly drop knees to one side, keeping shoulders flat.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.
breathingCue: Exhale as you twist, inhale returning to center.
trainerTip: A rotational stretch on a stability ball that targets the obliques and hip flexors.

name: Bridge Pose (Setu Bandhasana)
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet hip-width apart.
Place your arms at your sides, palms down.
Press through your heels and lift your hips upward.
Hold the pose, engaging your glutes and core.
Lower your hips back to the starting position.
breathingCue: Exhale as you lift hips, inhale as you lower down.
commonMistakes: Letting knees fall outward or inward
trainerTip: A yoga pose that stretches and activates the glutes, lower back, and hip flexors.

name: Cable Close Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Attach a V-bar or close grip handle to the cable machine.
Sit down and secure your thighs under the pads.
Grasp the handle with a neutral grip, hands parallel.
Pull the handle down to the top of your chest, keeping torso vertical.
Slowly return the handle to the top without locking elbows.
breathingCue: Exhale as you pull down, inhale as you return up.
trainerTip: A cable exercise using a close grip to target the latissimus dorsi and supporting back muscles.

name: Cable Crossover Reverse Fly
instructions: Set both cable handles to the low pulleys and stand centered between them.
Grab the left handle in your right hand and the right handle in your left hand, then step forward to create tension.
Hinge forward slightly with a soft bend in your knees and keep your chest up and back flat.
Start with your arms angled down and crossed in front of you, elbows slightly bent.
Pull both arms out and back in a wide arc until your hands reach about shoulder height.
Squeeze your rear shoulders and upper back at the end position.
Return the handles slowly to the start without shrugging or changing your torso position.
breathingCue: Inhale as you return the handles to the start, and exhale as you pull your arms out and back.
commonMistakes: Standing fully upright and turning it into a row
Bending and straightening the elbows during the rep
Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears
Swinging the torso to move the handles
trainerTip: A cable rear-delt fly where you pull crossed low handles out and back to train the back of the shoulders and upper back.

name: Cable Lying Triceps Extension
instructions: Attach a rope handle to a low cable and place a flat bench in line with the pulley.
Lie face up on the bench with your head closest to the cable and hold the rope with a neutral grip.
Press the rope straight above your chest with your arms fully extended.
Keep your upper arms mostly still and bend your elbows to lower the rope toward your forehead.
Pause briefly when your elbows are deeply bent.
Straighten your elbows to return the rope to the start position above your chest.
breathingCue: Inhale as you lower the rope toward your forehead, and exhale as you straighten your elbows back to the start.
commonMistakes: Letting the elbows flare wide to the sides
Drifting the upper arms backward and turning it into a pullover
Lowering the rope behind the head instead of toward the forehead
Bouncing out of the bottom instead of controlling the cable
trainerTip: A lying cable triceps exercise where you bend and straighten the elbows to move a rope handle over your chest.

name: Cable One Arm Front Raise
instructions: Attach handle to low pulley and stand facing away from machine.
Grasp handle with one hand, arm by your side.
With a straight arm, raise it forward to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower back to the start slowly and repeat.
breathingCue: Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.
trainerTip: An isolation exercise that raises the arm forward using a cable to target the front deltoid.

name: Cable One Arm Lateral Pulldown
instructions: Attach a single handle to the high cable pulley.
Sit or stand, arm overhead grasping the handle.
Stabilize your body and engage your core.
Pull handle down to shoulder/upper chest level.
Pause, then return handle slowly.
breathingCue: Exhale while pulling down, inhale while releasing.
trainerTip: A vertical pulling exercise that targets the latissimus dorsi using a single cable handle.

name: Cable One-Arm Twisting Seated Row
instructions: Sit on the cable row bench and grasp a single handle with one hand.
Keep back straight and feet planted on the platform.
Pull the handle toward your torso while rotating your shoulder and upper body toward the working side.
Pause and squeeze your back muscles at contraction.
Slowly return arm and torso to the starting position with control.
breathingCue: Exhale as you row and rotate, inhale as you extend and return.
trainerTip: A unilateral cable row variation adding torso rotation to activate both the lats and core.

name: Cable Rope Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley.
Stand (or kneel) with back facing the machine.
Grasp rope, step forward, and lean slightly.
Keep upper arms still, extend elbows bringing rope forward/upward.
Return to starting position slowly.
breathingCue: Exhale as you extend, inhale as you bend elbows.
trainerTip: An isolation exercise using a rope attachment on a high pulley to target the triceps overhead.

name: Cable Rope Triceps Pushdown
formCues: Split the rope at the bottom
instructions: Attach a rope to the high pulley and stand facing the machine.
Grab the rope with both hands, thumbs facing inward.
Keep elbows tucked at your sides and lean slightly forward.
Extend your arms down, splitting the rope at the bottom.
Slowly return to the start without letting elbows flare out.
breathingCue: Exhale as you push down, inhale as you return.
trainerTip: A cable isolation exercise targeting the triceps by pressing a rope attachment downward.

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Stand facing the cable stack with attachment at high position.
Grip the bar or rope with both hands.
Keep elbows tight to your body.
Push the attachment down until arms are fully extended.
Return slowly to starting position.
breathingCue: Exhale as you push down, inhale as you return up.
trainerTip: An isolation cable exercise targeting the triceps by extending the arm downward against resistance.

name: Calf Stretch with Strap
instructions: Sit with legs extended on the floor.
Loop a strap around the ball of one foot.
Hold strap ends and gently pull foot towards you.
Keep the knee straight and hold for desired time.
Switch sides and repeat.
breathingCue: Breathe deeply and steadily throughout stretch; exhale gently as you deepen the stretch.
trainerTip: A seated stretch using a strap or resistance band to elongate the calf muscles.

name: Cardio Exercise
instructions: Select a cardio activity (running, jumping jacks, etc).
Warm up for 3-5 minutes.
Perform the chosen activity at a sustainable pace.
Maintain movement for set time or rounds.
Cool down and stretch afterwards.
breathingCue: Breathe rhythmically; exhale on exertion, inhale during lower intensity.
trainerTip: Any aerobic physical activity aimed at increasing heart rate and cardiovascular health.

name: Cardio Machine Exercise
instructions: Choose your preferred cardio machine (treadmill, bike, etc).
Adjust resistance, incline, and settings as desired.
Begin with a brief warm-up.
Perform cardio at steady or variable intensity.
Cool down after session.
breathingCue: Breathe rhythmically according to intensity; exhale during exertion, inhale during recovery.
trainerTip: Any sustained aerobic activity using a cardio machine to increase heart rate and endurance.

name: Cardio Machine Workouts
instructions: Select a cardio machine suitable for your fitness level.
Adjust settings such as resistance, speed, and incline as desired.
Begin movement, focusing on steady pace and good posture.
Continue for your planned duration, monitoring intensity.
Cool down gradually and safely exit the machine.
breathingCue: Breathe steadily throughout the workout.
trainerTip: Cardio exercises on machines like treadmills, bikes, ellipticals, or rowers improve cardiovascular fitness and endurance.

name: Chest Dips
instructions: Grip parallel bars and lift to start.
Lean torso forward and bend elbows.
Lower until upper arms are parallel to floor.
Pause at the bottom, feeling the stretch.
Push up through palms, returning to start.
breathingCue: Inhale as you lower, exhale as you press up.
trainerTip: A compound bodyweight exercise performed on parallel bars to target the chest, shoulders, and triceps.

name: Chest Lift with Rotation
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on floor.
Place hands behind head, elbows wide.
Engage core and lift head, neck, and shoulders off mat.
Rotate torso to one side while lifting.
Return to center and lower down; repeat on alternate side.
breathingCue: Exhale as you lift and rotate, inhale as you lower.
trainerTip: An abdominal exercise that combines a chest lift with torso rotation to target the obliques.

name: Chin-to-Chest Stretch
instructions: Sit or stand with a straight back.
Gently lower your chin toward your chest.
Relax your shoulders and feel the stretch along your neck.
Hold the position for 15-30 seconds.
Slowly return to neutral.
breathingCue: Breathe deeply and evenly throughout the stretch.
trainerTip: A gentle static stretch to release tension in the neck flexors by tilting the chin toward the chest.

name: Close Feet Leg Press
formCues: Keep back and hips against pad
instructions: Sit in the leg press machine with feet close together on the platform.
Adjust seat and foot placement for comfort and safety.
Release safety handles and grip the handles for support.
Extend your knees to press the weight upward.
Lower platform slowly back to starting position.
breathingCue: Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower down.
trainerTip: A leg press using a narrow foot placement to emphasize the quadriceps.

name: Commando Pull-Up
instructions: Stand under a pull-up bar and grip it with hands facing each other, one in front of the other.
Hang with your body turned so the bar is directly in front of your face.
Brace your core and pull up, bringing your head to one side of the bar.
Lower yourself under control back to the starting position.
Repeat, bringing your head to the opposite side on the next rep.
breathingCue: Exhale as you pull up, inhale as you lower down.
trainerTip: A challenging pull-up variation using a parallel grip over the bar, emphasizing back, biceps, and grip strength.

name: Crossover Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Start in a kneeling lunge with one knee on the ground and the opposite foot forward.
Tuck the pelvis under and shift your weight forward, feeling a stretch in the hip flexor of the rear leg.
Rotate your torso across the body, away from the back leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Release and repeat on the other side.
breathingCue: Inhale to prepare, exhale as you rotate and deepen stretch.
trainerTip: A kneeling stretch targeting hip flexors with the trunk rotated across the body.

name: Decline Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Set a bench to a 45-degree decline angle.
Secure feet, lie back holding dumbbells over chest.
Lower dumbbells to the sides of your chest.
Pause at the bottom.
Press weights back to starting position.
breathingCue: Inhale as you lower the dumbbells, exhale as you press up.
trainerTip: A chest pressing exercise performed on a 45-degree decline bench using dumbbells.

name: Decline Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Set bench to 45-degree decline, secure feet.
Lie back, arms extended above chest, slight bend in elbows.
Lower dumbbells in a wide arc to sides.
Pause at bottom for a stretch.
Return dumbbells to starting position, squeezing chest.
breathingCue: Inhale as you open arms, exhale as you bring weights together.
trainerTip: A fly movement on a 45-degree decline bench to isolate the lower chest with dumbbells.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Shoulder Press
instructions: Hold dumbbells at shoulder level, palms facing forward.
Brace your core and press one dumbbell overhead until arm is fully extended.
Lower to shoulder height as you press the opposite dumbbell overhead.
Continue alternating arms with each rep.
Maintain upright posture and avoid arching back.
breathingCue: Exhale pressing up, inhale lowering down.
trainerTip: A shoulder press using dumbbells, pressing one arm at a time to target the deltoids and stabilizers.

name: Dumbbell Behind-the-Back Wrist Curl
instructions: Stand with dumbbell held behind your back, arm straight, palm facing backward.
Allow the dumbbell to roll down your fingers slightly.
Flex your wrist to curl the dumbbell up.
Squeeze at the top of the movement.
Lower the weight back down slowly.
breathingCue: Exhale during curl, inhale lowering down.
trainerTip: A forearm isolation exercise curling a dumbbell behind the back to emphasize forearm flexors.

name: Dumbbell Hammer Grip Incline Bench Row
instructions: Set an incline bench to 30-45 degrees and lie facedown with dumbbells.
Hold the dumbbells with palms facing each other (neutral/hammer grip).
Pull the dumbbells up toward your hips, elbows close to your body.
Pause and contract your back muscles at the top.
Lower the weights slowly with control.
breathingCue: Exhale pulling up, inhale lowering down.
trainerTip: A back-focused row performed chest-down on an incline bench with dumbbells and a neutral (hammer) grip.

name: Dumbbell Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down on a bench, legs straight, dumbbell held between your feet.
Hold onto the bench for stability.
Contract your hamstrings to curl the dumbbell upward toward your glutes.
Pause at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbell in a controlled motion to the starting position.
breathingCue: Exhale as you curl up, inhale as you lower down.
trainerTip: A hamstring isolation exercise where a dumbbell is held between the feet during leg curls.

name: Dumbbell One-Arm Triceps Extension
instructions: Hold dumbbell in one hand, arm extended overhead.
Support upper arm with free hand if needed.
Lower dumbbell behind head by bending the elbow.
Pause when forearm is parallel to ground.
Extend arm fully to return to starting position.
breathingCue: Inhale as you lower the dumbbell, exhale as you press up.
trainerTip: An isolation exercise for the triceps performed one arm at a time, with a dumbbell overhead.

name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Row
instructions: Stand with your feet hip- to shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Hinge at your hips until your torso is leaned forward, soften your knees, and let the dumbbells hang below your shoulders with your palms facing each other.
Brace your core and keep your back flat as you pull your elbows up and out to the sides.
Lift until your upper arms are roughly in line with your shoulders and squeeze your upper back.
Lower the dumbbells under control to the start position and repeat.
breathingCue: Inhale as you lower the dumbbells, and exhale as you row them up and out to the sides.
commonMistakes: Rounding the lower back as you hinge forward.
Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears.
Pulling the dumbbells straight back close to the ribs.
Swinging the torso to start each rep.
trainerTip: A bent-over dumbbell row variation that targets the rear delts by pulling the elbows out wide to the sides.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
instructions: Stand with feet wide apart, toes angled outward.
Grip the dumbbell vertically between your legs.
Keep chest up and core braced.
Squat down, pushing knees outward.
Drive through heels to stand up.
breathingCue: Inhale as you lower down, exhale as you stand up.
trainerTip: A lower body exercise using a dumbbell in a sumo stance to target the glutes, quads, and adductors.

name: Dynamic Chest Stretch
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend both arms out to your sides at shoulder height.
Swing your arms forward, crossing them in front of your chest.
Open your arms wide, stretching your chest as you do.
Repeat the swinging motion for the desired number of repetitions.
breathingCue: Breathe naturally throughout the movement.
trainerTip: A rhythmic arm movement to increase chest mobility and warm up the pectoral muscles.

name: Elliptical Trainer
instructions: Step onto the pedals and hold the handles.
Select desired resistance and incline.
Begin moving feet in a smooth, elliptical pattern.
Push and pull the handles with your arms in sync with your strides.
Maintain a steady cadence and upright posture.
breathingCue: Maintain rhythmic, deep breathing throughout the workout.
commonMistakes: Leaning too far forward or backward
Relying only on legs or arms
trainerTip: A low-impact cardio exercise using a standing elliptical machine for total body endurance and aerobic gains.

name: Exercise Ball Sit-Up
instructions: Sit on the exercise ball with feet flat on the floor.
Walk feet forward, rolling until the ball supports your lower back.
Cross arms over your chest or position hands behind your head.
Engage your core and sit up, lifting your upper body.
Lower back down under control to starting position.
breathingCue: Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.
commonMistakes: Ball not positioned under lower back
trainerTip: A core exercise where sit-ups are performed while stabilizing on a Swiss ball, increasing abdominal activation.

name: Exercise Ball Spinal Stretch
instructions: Sit on the exercise ball with feet hip-width apart.
Slowly walk your feet forward, rolling until your back is draped over the ball.
Let your arms extend overhead or rest beside you for support.
Relax into the stretch, allowing your spine to gently extend.
Hold for the desired duration, then carefully return to a seated position.
breathingCue: Breathe deeply and steadily throughout the stretch.
trainerTip: A gentle back extension and stretch performed by draping the body over an exercise ball to mobilize the spine.

name: EZ Bar Biceps Curl
instructions: Grip the EZ bar at angled sections, palms facing up.
Stand tall with arms fully extended and elbows anchored.
Curl the bar upward, contracting the biceps.
Pause and squeeze at the top.
Lower the bar down slowly.
breathingCue: Exhale as you lift, inhale lowering the bar.
trainerTip: Classic biceps curl using an EZ barbell to build arm mass with ergonomic grip.

name: EZ Bar Lying Triceps Extension
instructions: Lie on bench, grip EZ bar with medium width.
Extend arms fully above chest.
Bend elbows, lowering bar toward forehead.
Keep upper arms stationary.
Extend to starting position, repeat.
breathingCue: Inhale lowering bar, exhale extending arms.
commonMistakes: Lowering bar too far past head
trainerTip: Lying triceps extension using EZ bar to target triceps with reduced wrist strain.

name: Feet and Ankles Rotation Stretch
instructions: Sit or stand and lift one foot off the ground.
Point your toes and slowly rotate your ankle in circles.
Make several circles clockwise, then reverse to counterclockwise.
Repeat for the other ankle.
Maintain steady breathing and controlled motion.
breathingCue: Breathe normally throughout the stretch.
trainerTip: A mobility exercise involving circular ankle movements that target the calves and improve ankle flexibility.

name: Feet and Ankles Stretch
formCues: Hold gentle tension, do not force
instructions: Sit or stand with legs extended or positioned comfortably.
Point your toes downward to stretch the top of your feet and fronts of your ankles.
Flex your toes upward toward your shins to stretch the calves and back of the ankles.
Hold each position for 15-30 seconds.
Repeat the sequence for several reps.
breathingCue: Breathe normally throughout, or exhale as you relax into each stretch.
commonMistakes: Overstretching or forcing range of motion
trainerTip: A stretch to increase flexibility and mobility in the feet and ankle muscles.

name: Flat Bench Cable Fly
instructions: Set a flat bench between two cable pulleys and attach handles.
Lie back and grip each handle with arms extended.
With elbows slightly bent, bring handles together above your chest.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Slowly return to the starting position with control.
breathingCue: Exhale as you bring hands together, inhale as you return.
trainerTip: A chest isolation exercise using cables while lying on a flat bench for continuous tension.

name: Flexion Leg Sit-Up Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Cross arms over chest or reach toward knees.
Contract abdominal muscles to sit up, curling your spine.
Reach for your knees at the top to enhance the stretch.
Lower back to starting position with control.
breathingCue: Exhale as you sit up, inhale as you lower down.
trainerTip: A stretch that combines trunk flexion with leg movement to lengthen the abdominals and hip flexors.

name: Floor Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet hip-width apart.
Place hands lightly behind head or cross over chest.
Engage core and lift shoulders off the floor.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position.
breathingCue: Exhale as you crunch up, inhale as you lower down.
trainerTip: A basic abdominal crunch performed lying on the floor to strengthen the rectus abdominis.

name: Front Plank
instructions: Lie face down, placing forearms on the ground and elbows under shoulders.
Lift your body off the floor, supporting weight on forearms and toes.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core and glutes for stability.
Hold the position for the prescribed time, then lower to the ground.
breathingCue: Breathe slowly and steadily during the hold.
trainerTip: An isometric core stability exercise performed in a prone position to strengthen the abdominals and stabilize the entire body.

name: Front Toe Touch Stretch
formCues: Keep head in line with spine
instructions: Stand (or sit) with legs straight.
Bend slowly forward from the hips, keeping a flat back.
Reach towards or touch your toes with your hands.
Keep knees straight but not locked.
Hold stretch, then return to starting position.
breathingCue: Exhale as you bend forward, inhale as you return upright.
trainerTip: A classic stretch where you bend forward to touch your toes, lengthening the hamstrings and lower back.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Start lying on back with knees bent, feet hip-width apart.
Arms rest at sides, palms down.
Push through heels, lifting hips toward ceiling.
Pause and squeeze glutes at top.
Lower hips back to floor.
breathingCue: Exhale as you lift hips, inhale as you lower down.
trainerTip: A floor-based exercise that strengthens the glutes and hamstrings by lifting the hips.

name: Hip Circles Stretch
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart, hands on hips.
Lift one knee up in front of you.
Move your knee and thigh in a circular motion outward.
Reverse and perform circles inward after the set.
Switch legs and repeat.
breathingCue: Inhale and exhale naturally during the stretch.
trainerTip: A dynamic stretch to increase mobility in the hips by performing circular leg movements.

name: Hip Extension Stretch
instructions: Lie face down with legs extended.
Place hands beneath shoulders, elbows bent.
Press palms into floor, lifting chest and gently extending hips.
Hold the stretch at a comfortable tension.
Slowly lower back down.
breathingCue: Inhale while preparing, exhale as you press up into stretch.
trainerTip: A stretch focused on extending the hip to target tight hip flexors and anterior hips.

name: Hip Flexor and Quadriceps Stretch
instructions: Begin in a half-kneeling position, one knee down, one foot forward.
Keep torso upright with hands on hips or front knee.
Push hips forward slightly to increase the stretch.
Feel the stretch in the hip flexor and thigh of the back leg.
Hold for desired time, then switch legs.
breathingCue: Breathe deeply and steadily throughout the stretch.
commonMistakes: Letting front knee go past toes
trainerTip: A stretch that lengthens the hip flexors and quadriceps by using a kneeling or lunge position.

name: Incline Leg Hip Raise
instructions: Lie face up on an incline bench and grip the handles behind your head.
Extend your legs straight and keep them together.
Raise your legs towards your chest, lifting your hips off the bench.
Pause at the top, focusing on contracting your abs.
Lower your legs under control to the starting position.
breathingCue: Exhale as you lift hips, inhale as you lower legs.
trainerTip: A core exercise where legs and hips are raised while lying on an incline, targeting the lower abdominals.

name: Inverted Row Between Chairs
instructions: Set up a sturdy bar between two heavy chairs.
Lie underneath with your chest directly below the bar.
Grip the bar with an overhand, shoulder-width grip.
Brace your body, keeping a straight line from head to heels.
Pull your chest to the bar, pause, then lower yourself slowly.
breathingCue: Exhale as you pull up, inhale as you lower down.
trainerTip: A bodyweight pulling exercise performed using a bar or sturdy broomstick supported between two chairs.

name: Jackknife
instructions: Lie on your back with arms at your sides and legs extended.
Engage your core and lift legs towards the ceiling.
Continue lifting hips off the mat, reaching feet upward.
Pause at the top with hips elevated.
Slowly roll back down vertebra by vertebra.
breathingCue: Exhale while lifting up, inhale while lowering down.
trainerTip: A Pilates core exercise involving lifting hips and legs up and overhead to strengthen the abdominals.

name: Jackknife Floor
instructions: Lie flat with arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Engage your core, lift arms and legs toward each other.
Reach hands toward feet, forming a 'V' at the top.
Pause briefly, squeezing at the top.
Lower back down slowly to starting position.
breathingCue: Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.
commonMistakes: Bending knees or elbows too much
trainerTip: A dynamic ab exercise where you simultaneously raise legs and torso to touch in a 'V' position.

name: Jackknife Split Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Engage your core and simultaneously lift your torso and legs off the ground.
As you rise, spread your legs into a split while reaching your hands toward your feet.
Pause at the top, squeezing your abs.
Lower your legs and torso back to the ground with control, bringing feet together.
breathingCue: Exhale when crunching up, inhale when lowering down.
trainerTip: A crunch variation combining a V-up with a leg split to target the abs and hip flexors.

name: Jump Step-Up
formCues: Drive explosively through the lead leg
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box or platform.
Place one foot firmly on top of the box.
Drive through the heel and explode upward, lifting your other knee high.
Land softly on the box with both feet.
Step or jump down with control and repeat.
breathingCue: Exhale during the jump, inhale as you land and reset.
commonMistakes: Not using full range of motion
trainerTip: A plyometric exercise involving stepping and jumping onto a raised surface to build leg power and coordination.

name: Jumping Jack
instructions: Start with feet together and arms relaxed at your sides.
Jump feet out to shoulder-width as you raise arms overhead.
Briefly touch hands or keep arms straight above head.
Jump feet back together and arms down to sides.
Repeat at a brisk pace.
breathingCue: Breathe evenly throughout the movement.
trainerTip: A dynamic total-body movement for cardiovascular and muscular endurance.

name: Kettlebell Deadlift
instructions: Place kettlebell between your feet; stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at hips and bend knees, keeping back flat and chest up.
Grip the kettlebell handle with both hands.
Drive through your heels to stand up, fully extending hips and knees.
Lower the kettlebell to the floor under control by hinging at the hips.
breathingCue: Exhale as you stand up, inhale as you lower down.
trainerTip: A hip hinge movement using a kettlebell from the floor to standing, building posterior chain and grip strength.

name: Kneeling Back Rotation Stretch
instructions: Kneel on the floor (all fours or lunge position).
Place one hand behind your head or neck.
Rotate elbow and upper body upward, opening chest.
Hold for a moment at top of rotation.
Return to start and repeat; switch sides.
breathingCue: Exhale as you rotate, inhale returning to start.
trainerTip: A mobility stretch that improves thoracic spine rotation while kneeling, also opening the chest and shoulders.

name: Kneeling Triceps Stretch
instructions: Kneel on the floor or mat.
Raise one arm overhead then bend the elbow so your hand touches your upper back.
Use your other hand to gently push on the bent elbow.
Hold the stretch.
Switch arms and repeat.
breathingCue: Breathe deeply and steadily throughout the stretch.
trainerTip: A static stretch targeting the triceps and lats by flexing the elbow overhead while kneeling.

name: Leg Raise Crunch
formCues: Keep lower back pressed to floor
instructions: Lie on your back and extend your legs.
Place your hands by your sides or behind your head.
Simultaneously lift your legs and upper torso toward each other.
Squeeze at the top of the movement.
Lower your legs and upper body back down under control.
breathingCue: Exhale during the crunch, inhale as you return.
trainerTip: An ab exercise combining a crunch with a leg raise to emphasize upper and lower abdominals.

name: Leg Raise with Hip Lift
instructions: Lie flat with arms at your sides and legs straight.
Raise your legs up together towards the ceiling.
At the top of the movement, press your legs up by lifting your hips off the ground.
Pause, squeezing your abs.
Lower your hips and legs back to the starting position slowly.
breathingCue: Exhale during hip lift, inhale during the descent.
trainerTip: A core exercise combining a leg raise with a hip lift to target the lower abdominals.

name: Lever Horizontal Leg Press
formCues: Keep lower back pressed into seat
instructions: Sit on the leg press and adjust seat as needed.
Place feet shoulder-width apart on platform.
Push platform away by extending legs.
Do not lock knees at the top position.
Lower platform under control to start position.
breathingCue: Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower down.
trainerTip: A horizontal plate-loaded machine exercise targeting the entire thigh, especially the quadriceps.

name: Lever Incline Hammer Chest Press
instructions: Adjust seat height for optimal handle position.
Sit and grip handles with elbows bent.
Press handles up and forward above chest.
Avoid locking elbows completely.
Lower handles slowly to starting position.
breathingCue: Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower down.
trainerTip: A machine-based incline chest press emphasizing the upper chest and shoulders.

name: Lever Lying Chest Press
instructions: Lie supine on the machine bench.
Grip the handles firmly, elbows bent.
Engage chest and press handles forward and up.
Fully extend arms without locking out elbows.
Slowly return to starting position.
breathingCue: Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower down.
trainerTip: A plate-loaded machine press mimicking the bench press to target the entire chest safely.

name: Lever Standing Hip Extension
instructions: Adjust the machine to your height.
Place one foot on platform, chest against pad.
Brace core and grasp handles for balance.
Extend hip, pressing lever back with heel.
Return to starting position and repeat.
breathingCue: Exhale as you extend hip, inhale as you return.
trainerTip: A machine-based hip extension to isolate and strengthen the glutes.

name: Lever Standing Rear Kick
instructions: Adjust the lever machine pad to chest height and select weight.
Place working foot on the platform.
Hold handles and brace core.
Extend hip by pushing foot backward as far as comfortable.
Return slowly to starting position and repeat.
breathingCue: Exhale as you kick back, inhale as you return.
trainerTip: A leverage machine exercise that isolates the glutes with a hip extension rear kick motion.

name: Lying Hip Lift on Stability Ball
instructions: Lie on your back with arms by your sides and feet on the stability ball.
Bend knees at 90 degrees and keep feet hip-width apart.
Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips.
Pause at the top, keeping your body in a straight line.
Lower your hips back down with control.
breathingCue: Exhale when lifting hips, inhale when lowering hips.
trainerTip: A hip-thrusting exercise using a stability ball to engage glutes, hamstrings, and core.

name: Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lie flat on your back, legs straight.
Keep arms at your sides or under hips.
Lift legs upward, keeping knees straight.
Raise legs until hips come up slightly.
Lower legs slowly without touching the floor.
breathingCue: Exhale as you raise legs, inhale as you lower.
commonMistakes: Touching feet to ground between reps
trainerTip: A bodyweight exercise that targets the lower abdominal muscles by lifting the legs while lying flat.

name: Lying Quadriceps Stretch
instructions: Lie on your stomach with legs extended.
Bend one knee, bringing heel toward glute.
Reach back and grasp ankle with hand.
Gently pull heel closer to glute until a stretch is felt.
Hold, then switch sides.
breathingCue: Exhale as you pull, inhale to release.
trainerTip: A stretch for the quadriceps performed lying on the stomach for maximal knee flexion.

name: Lying Scissor Kick
instructions: Lie on your back with legs extended and arms at your sides.
Lift both legs a few inches off the ground, keeping them straight.
Alternate raising one leg while lowering the other in a scissor motion.
Continue to alternate legs in a controlled manner.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed, core engaged.
breathingCue: Exhale as legs rise, inhale as legs lower.
trainerTip: A core and hip flexor exercise performed while lying flat, alternately raising and lowering legs in a scissor-like motion.

name: Lying Straight Leg Raise
instructions: Lie flat on your back, arms at sides.
Extend legs fully, feet together.
Lift legs straight up to vertical.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower legs down slowly but don’t touch floor.
breathingCue: Exhale as you lift legs, inhale as you lower.
trainerTip: An exercise to isolate the hip flexors and lower abdominals from a supine position.

name: Medicine Ball Wall Sit-Up
instructions: Sit on the floor facing a wall, knees bent.
Hold a medicine ball at your chest.
Lie back, then perform a sit-up.
At the top, throw the ball against the wall.
Catch the rebound and lower back down.
breathingCue: Exhale as you sit up/throw, inhale as you lower down.
trainerTip: A dynamic core exercise involving a sit-up while throwing and catching a medicine ball against a wall.

name: Middle Back Stretch
instructions: Sit or stand with feet hip-width apart.
Extend your arms straight in front and clasp your hands.
Round your upper back and push your hands forward.
Tuck your chin slightly toward your chest.
Hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds and release.
breathingCue: Breathe slowly and evenly throughout the stretch.
commonMistakes: Arching the lower back instead of rounding the upper back
trainerTip: A static stretch to lengthen the muscles of the thoracic (middle) back region.

name: Military Press
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and barbell at shoulder height.
Grip the bar with hands just outside shoulder-width.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the barbell overhead to full arm extension.
Lower the bar slowly back to shoulders.
breathingCue: Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower down.
trainerTip: A standing barbell press that builds overall shoulder strength and stability.

name: Old School Reverse Extensions
instructions: Lie face down on the floor or bench with elbows bent and hands at your sides.
Position elbows by your torso.
Straighten your arms fully behind you, contracting your triceps.
Pause and squeeze at full extension.
Return to the start in a controlled manner.
breathingCue: Exhale as you extend your arms, inhale as you return.
trainerTip: This bodyweight movement isolates the triceps by extending the elbows while lying face down.

name: Overhead Chest Stretch
instructions: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart.
Interlace fingers and stretch arms straight overhead.
Gently pull arms back behind head.
Squeeze shoulder blades together.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
breathingCue: Breathe deeply and steadily throughout the stretch.
trainerTip: A static stretch that opens the chest by extending the arms overhead and pulling back.

name: Pec Deck Fly
instructions: Adjust seat and sit with back against pad.
Place forearms on pads with elbows slightly bent.
Bring arms together in a wide arc.
Squeeze chest at the end of movement.
Return slowly to starting position.
breathingCue: Exhale as you bring arms together, inhale as you open.
trainerTip: A machine-based isolation exercise focusing on squeezing the chest muscles through a fly motion.

name: Pilates Corkscrew
instructions: Lie on back, arms by side, legs straight up.
Engage core, lift hips off mat gently.
Circle legs together in a clockwise motion.
Lower hips as legs complete the circle.
Reverse the circle direction.
breathingCue: Exhale as you circle legs, inhale to prepare.
trainerTip: A Pilates core exercise where the legs draw a circular motion to challenge abdominal stability.

name: Pilates Hundred
instructions: Lie on back, legs in tabletop or extended.
Lift head, neck, shoulders off mat.
Extend arms at sides, hovering above floor.
Pump arms up and down vigorously.
Inhale for 5 pumps, exhale for 5 pumps; repeat to 100.
breathingCue: Inhale for 5 pumps, exhale for 5 pumps, continue cycle.
trainerTip: A classic Pilates exercise involving rhythmic arm pumps and core engagement.

name: Plyometric Side Lunge Stretch
instructions: Stand with feet wider than hip-width apart.
Shift your weight to one side, bending the knee and keeping the opposite leg straight.
Drop into a deep lunge while maintaining upright posture.
Push off the bent leg and return to starting position.
Repeat to the opposite side in a dynamic, alternating fashion.
breathingCue: Inhale as you prepare and exhale moving into each lunge.
trainerTip: A dynamic stretch to warm up and mobilize the hips, inner thighs, and legs.

name: Pull-Up (Wide Grip)
instructions: Grip pull-up bar with hands wider than shoulders, palms overhand.
Hang with arms fully extended and core tight.
Pull chest up to bar, driving elbows down and out.
Pause at the top, squeeze back muscles.
Lower down slowly to full extension.
breathingCue: Exhale as you pull up, inhale as you lower down.
trainerTip: A pull-up variation performed with a wide, overhand grip to emphasize the upper lats and back.

name: Pull-Up / Chin-Up
instructions: Stand under a pull-up bar and grip it with your chosen grip (overhand for pull-up, underhand for chin-up).
Hang at full arm extension with shoulders engaged.
Brace your core and pull your chest up toward the bar by driving elbows down.
Clear the bar with your chin or chest as you squeeze your lats.
Lower yourself under control to the starting hang position.
breathingCue: Exhale as you pull up, inhale as you lower down.
trainerTip: A bodyweight pulling exercise that develops lat and upper body strength using a hanging bar.

name: Rear Foot Elevated Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Stand with your back to a bench; place one foot on the bench.
Step the front foot forward and lower into a lunge.
Tuck pelvis under, keeping chest tall.
Lean gently forward to intensify the stretch.
Hold, then switch legs.
breathingCue: Inhale to prepare, exhale as you sink into the stretch.
trainerTip: A deep hip flexor stretch with the rear foot elevated for improved flexibility.

name: Resistance Band High Fly
instructions: Anchor resistance band above shoulder height.
Grasp handles and step forward for tension.
Start with arms raised wide, aligned with shoulders.
Pull arms downward and together in a wide arc.
Squeeze chest, then return slowly to start.
breathingCue: Exhale as you bring arms together, inhale as you return.
trainerTip: A chest isolation movement where resistance bands are used to fly arms downward from above shoulder height.

name: Reverse Dip Stretch
instructions: Sit with legs extended and arms behind your hips.
Place hands flat on the floor, fingers pointing forward.
Press through your palms to lift your chest up.
Keep your arms long without locking elbows.
Hold for the stretch, then slowly lower and relax.
breathingCue: Breathe deeply and steadily throughout the stretch.
trainerTip: A stretch targeting the triceps and shoulders by extending the arms behind the body and lowering the torso.

name: Reverse-Grip Cable Lat Pulldown
instructions: Set the cable bar attachment and sit with knees secured under the pad.
Grasp the bar with a reverse (supinated) shoulder-width grip.
Lean back slightly, chest up, arms fully extended.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest by contracting your lats.
Slowly return the bar to the start position with control.
breathingCue: Exhale as you pull down, inhale as you return up.
trainerTip: A cable pulldown variation using an underhand (supinated) grip to emphasize the lower lats and biceps.

name: Ring High Row
instructions: Adjust rings to chest height and grip handles with neutral grip.
Lean back with feet forward and body straight.
Engage core, keep arms extended.
Row your chest toward the rings, retracting shoulder blades.
Lower body back to start under control.
breathingCue: Exhale as you pull, inhale as you lower.
trainerTip: A suspended horizontal pulling movement using rings set high to target upper back and rear shoulder muscles.

name: Rotational Push-Up
instructions: Begin in a standard push-up position.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
As you press up, rotate your torso and lift one arm toward the ceiling.
Hold briefly, keeping hips square.
Return to start, repeat on the other side.
breathingCue: Exhale when pushing up and rotating, inhale when lowering.
trainerTip: A push-up variation involving a torso rotation to challenge the chest, shoulders, triceps, and core.

name: Running
instructions: Warm up with light walking or dynamic stretches.
Begin running at a moderate pace.
Maintain a steady breathing rhythm and upright posture.
Land lightly with a midfoot or forefoot strike.
Cool down with walking and stretching.
breathingCue: Exhale steadily as you push off, inhale as you recover.
trainerTip: A repetitive aerobic movement that improves cardiovascular fitness and endurance.

name: Russian Twist on Stability Ball (Arms Straight)
instructions: Sit on a stability ball and walk feet forward until shoulders rest on the ball.
Keep knees bent at 90 degrees, hips lifted in a bridge position.
Extend arms straight toward the ceiling with hands together.
Rotate torso and arms as one unit to the left.
Return to center, then rotate to the right, repeating for reps.
breathingCue: Exhale during each rotation, inhale as you return to center.
trainerTip: An advanced core exercise targeting the obliques by rotating the torso while balanced on a stability ball with arms extended.

name: Seated Alternating Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Sit with back against support and feet flat.
Hold dumbbells at your sides, palms facing in.
Curl one dumbbell while rotating palm up.
Lower to starting position and alternate arms.
Repeat, keeping back straight and elbows close to sides.
breathingCue: Exhale as you curl up, inhale as you lower down.
trainerTip: A seated exercise curling dumbbells alternately to build bicep size and strength.

name: Seated Bent Over Back Stretch
instructions: Sit comfortably on the floor, legs extended or crossed.
Hinge forward at the hips, keeping back relaxed.
Let arms reach forward toward feet or floor.
Lower your chest toward your knees, breathing deeply.
Hold the stretch and relax into the position.
breathingCue: Inhale before bending, exhale as you fold forward.
trainerTip: A static stretch performed while seated, bending forward to lengthen the lower and upper back muscles.

name: Seated Boat Stretch
formCues: Go only as far as comfortable
instructions: Sit on the floor with back straight.
Bring soles of feet together and let knees drop out.
Hold ankles or feet for support.
Gently pull feet closer and lean forward slightly.
Hold position without bouncing.
breathingCue: Breathe deeply and regularly while holding the stretch.
trainerTip: A seated flexibility stretch focusing on the inner thighs and hips.

name: Seated Cable Row (V-Grip)
instructions: Sit on the cable row machine and place feet on the foot platform.
Grab the V-grip handle with both hands, arms extended.
Maintain a straight back and slight knee bend.
Pull the handle toward your abdomen, retracting your shoulder blades.
Slowly extend arms to return to the starting position.
breathingCue: Exhale as you row back, inhale as you extend forward.
trainerTip: A compound cable exercise targeting the mid-back and lats using a V-grip handle.

name: Seated Cable Row (Wide-Grip)
instructions: Sit down and place feet against the platform.
Grasp the wide grip attachment with both hands.
Keep your torso upright, arms fully extended.
Pull the handle toward your upper abdomen, squeezing your upper back.
Slowly release back to the start position.
breathingCue: Exhale as you pull, inhale as you extend arms.
trainerTip: A cable row variation using a wide grip to target the upper back and rear deltoids.

name: Seated Calf Stretch
instructions: Sit with legs extended straight in front.
Loop a towel or band around one foot's ball.
Keep knee straight and pull your toes toward you.
Hold position, feeling stretch in calf.
Repeat on the other leg.
breathingCue: Breathe steadily and deeply throughout the stretch.
trainerTip: A stretch performed while seated, focusing on lengthening the calf muscles.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support and feet flat.
Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, elbows bent.
Press dumbbells overhead until arms are extended.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower dumbbells to starting position.
breathingCue: Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower down.
trainerTip: A pressing movement targeting the shoulders, performed seated with dumbbells.

name: Seated Shoulder Flexor, Depressor, Retractor Stretch
instructions: Sit tall with feet flat.
Lift arms overhead, reaching upward.
Gently depress the shoulders away from your ears.
Retract shoulder blades by pulling them slightly together.
Hold for a stretch, breathing evenly.
breathingCue: Inhale to begin, exhale as you stretch deeper.
trainerTip: A seated stretch focusing on improving flexibility and mobility in the front, lower, and rear shoulder muscles.

name: Seated Straight Arm Twist
instructions: Sit with knees bent, feet either flat or off the ground.
Extend arms straight forward, clasping hands.
Lean back slightly with a neutral spine.
Rotate torso to one side, arms following movement.
Return to center and repeat to opposite side.
breathingCue: Exhale as you twist, inhale returning to center.
commonMistakes: Using just arms instead of rotating the torso
Moving too quickly or without control
trainerTip: Seated torso rotation with arms straight to target the obliques and core stability.

name: Seated Twist on Stability Ball
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with feet flat, core engaged.
Hold arms in front or across chest.
Rotate your torso to the right, keeping hips stationary.
Pause, then twist to the left.
Return to center, repeat alternately.
breathingCue: Exhale during the twist, inhale as you return to center.
trainerTip: A rotational core exercise performed while seated on a stability ball to target the obliques.

name: Seated Twist Stretch (Straight Arm)
instructions: Sit upright with legs extended forward.
Cross your left leg over your right if desired for more stretch.
Extend your right arm straight behind you for support.
Twist your torso toward your right, using the opposite arm for leverage.
Hold, then repeat to the other side.
breathingCue: Breathe steadily while holding the stretch.
trainerTip: A flexibility exercise involving seated trunk rotation to stretch the obliques and lower back.

name: Shoulder-Width Pull-Up
instructions: Grip bar shoulder-width, palms away.
Hang with arms fully extended.
Pull up until chin clears the bar.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower down slowly to full extension.
breathingCue: Exhale pulling up, inhale lowering down.
trainerTip: A classic bodyweight exercise targeting the lats and upper back with a shoulder-width overhand grip.

name: Side Bend on Stability Ball
instructions: Position yourself sideways on a stability ball, feet braced.
Place top hand behind head, other hand for balance.
Lower your torso over the ball for a stretch.
Contract your side to lift torso up in a side bend.
Lower back down with control, repeat.
breathingCue: Exhale as you crunch up, inhale as you lower.
trainerTip: A lateral flexion movement performed on a stability ball to target the obliques.

name: Side Bend Stretch
instructions: Stand or sit tall with spine neutral.
Raise right arm overhead.
Slowly bend torso to the left, keeping hips steady.
Hold stretch for time, feeling the pull in your side.
Return to start and repeat on the other side.
breathingCue: Exhale as you bend, inhale as you return to upright.
trainerTip: A standing lateral bending stretch focusing on lengthening the obliques and side body muscles.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your side, elbow stacked under shoulder.
Stack your feet or place one in front of the other.
Raise hips up to create a straight line.
Hold body in line, keeping abs and glutes engaged.
Lower hips gently to finish; switch sides.
breathingCue: Breathe steadily throughout the hold.
trainerTip: A core-strengthening hold performed on one side, engaging the obliques and stabilizing hip muscles.

name: Single Dumbbell Stiff-Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand upright holding a dumbbell with both hands at your thighs.
Keep a slight bend in your knees and your back flat.
Hinge forward at the hips, lowering the dumbbell towards the floor.
Pause at the bottom while feeling a stretch in your hamstrings.
Return to the upright position by driving hips forward.
breathingCue: Inhale lowering, exhale as you stand back up.
trainerTip: A stiff-legged deadlift variation using a single dumbbell to target the hamstrings and lower back.

name: Single Leg Stretch (Bent Knee)
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs bent.
Grasp one knee with both hands.
Pull the knee toward your chest gently.
Hold the stretch, keeping your back flat.
Switch sides and repeat.
breathingCue: Exhale as you pull the knee in, inhale as you release.
trainerTip: A floor stretch to target hip flexors and hamstrings by pulling one bent leg towards the chest.

name: Single Straight Leg Stretch
formCues: Point or flex foot for deeper stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Lift one leg up while keeping it straight.
Hold the back of your thigh or calf gently.
Pull the leg slightly toward your chest.
Hold and switch legs.
breathingCue: Exhale as you stretch the leg, inhale as you lower it.
trainerTip: A floor stretch focusing on the hamstrings by raising and holding one straight leg toward the body.

name: Sit-Up
instructions: Lie flat on your back with knees bent and feet anchored.
Place hands behind your head or across your chest.
Engage your core to lift your torso to a seated position.
Pause at the top, then slowly lower back to the floor.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
breathingCue: Exhale as you rise, inhale as you lower.
trainerTip: A classic ab exercise involving lifting the torso from the floor to a seated position to build core strength.

name: Sled 45 Degree Calf Press
formCues: Drive through the balls of feet
Lift heels as high as possible
instructions: Sit in the 45-degree sled machine and place the balls of both feet on the lower edge of the platform with your heels hanging off.
Straighten your legs enough to support the sled and keep a small bend in your knees.
Let your heels drop down by bending at the ankles until you feel a stretch in your calves.
Press through the balls of your feet and raise your heels as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top while keeping your legs steady.
Lower your heels under control back to the stretched position and repeat.
breathingCue: Inhale as you lower your heels, and exhale as you press through the balls of your feet to raise them.
commonMistakes: Bending and straightening the knees instead of moving only at the ankles
Placing the whole foot flat on the platform so the heels cannot drop
Bouncing out of the bottom instead of lowering under control
Turning the toes excessively in or out during the rep
trainerTip: A seated calf exercise on a 45-degree sled where you press through the balls of your feet to raise and lower the heels.

name: Sled 45 Degree Wide Leg Press
formCues: Keep knees in line with toes
Do not lock knees at top
instructions: Adjust the seat and load desired weight.
Sit with your back and head against the pad, feet flat and wide on the platform.
Release the safety handles and grasp the side handles.
Bend your knees to lower the platform until your thighs reach 90 degrees or just past.
Press through your heels to extend your legs fully, but avoid locking out the knees.
breathingCue: Inhale as you lower the platform, exhale as you press it back up.
trainerTip: A compound lower body movement targeting the quadriceps with emphasis on glutes and adductors due to a wide foot stance.

name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
instructions: Set up the Smith machine bar at shoulder height.
Step under the bar, position it across your upper traps, and unrack.
Stand upright with feet hip to shoulder-width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet by extending your ankles.
Pause at the top, then lower your heels in a controlled manner.
breathingCue: Exhale as you rise, inhale as you lower.
trainerTip: A standing calf raise using a Smith machine to isolate and strengthen the calf muscles.

name: Smith Machine Deadlift
instructions: Position feet shoulder-width beneath the Smith bar.
Grip the bar just outside your knees with both hands.
Hinge hips back and lower torso, keeping chest up.
Extend hips and knees to lift the bar along the guides.
Lower the bar with control to the starting position.
breathingCue: Inhale as you lower the bar, exhale as you lift.
commonMistakes: Lifting with arms instead of legs
Letting the bar drift away from body
trainerTip: A guided barbell deadlift performed with a Smith machine to build lower back, glutes, and hamstrings strength.

name: Smith Machine Leg Press
instructions: Set the safety stops and load the appropriate weight.
Lie under the Smith bar and position feet wider than shoulder-width on the bar.
Unrack the bar by rotating your feet upward.
Lower the bar slowly toward your torso until legs form roughly a 90-degree angle.
Press the bar up by extending your knees and hips.
breathingCue: Inhale as you lower the bar, exhale as you press upward.
trainerTip: A machine-based variation of leg press performed with a Smith machine barbell in a supine or incline position.

name: Squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly outward.
Brace core and keep chest up.
Initiate movement by pushing hips back and bending knees.
Descend until thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Push through heels to return to standing.
breathingCue: Inhale as you lower down, exhale as you stand up.
trainerTip: A foundational lower body movement that strengthens the quads, glutes, and hamstrings by bending and straightening the knees and hips.

name: Stability Ball Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face up on the floor, arms at your sides, heels on a stability ball.
Lift hips to form a straight line from shoulders to heels.
Bend knees to roll the ball toward your glutes.
Pause and squeeze your hamstrings.
Extend your legs to roll the ball back out.
breathingCue: Exhale as you curl in, inhale as you extend out.
trainerTip: A hamstring-focused curl using a stability ball for both resistance and core engagement.

name: Stability Ball Leg Elevated Crunch
formCues: Keep lower back pressed to floor
Do not pull with your neck
instructions: Place stability ball in front of you and sit down.
Lie back and position your calves and feet on top of the ball with knees bent.
Place your hands lightly behind your head or crossed on your chest.
Engage your core and curl your upper body toward your knees.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower back down without losing control.
breathingCue: Exhale as you crunch up, inhale as you lower down.
trainerTip: A crunch variation where the legs rest on a stability ball, increasing core engagement and instability.

name: Stairs Calf Stretch
formCues: Keep knees straight but not locked
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step or stair.
Support yourself with a railing, wall, or sturdy object.
Lower your heels slowly below the step to feel a stretch in your calves.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
Raise heels back up and repeat as desired.
breathingCue: Exhale as you lower into the stretch, inhale as you return.
trainerTip: A stretch performed using stairs to lengthen and increase flexibility in the calf muscles.

name: Standing Adductor Stretch
instructions: Stand wide with feet apart.
Shift weight to one leg, bending at the knee.
Keep the opposite leg straight and toes forward.
Lean gently toward the bent knee for a deep inner thigh stretch.
Hold, then switch to the other side.
breathingCue: Breathe deeply and steadily while holding the stretch.
trainerTip: A static stretch targeting the inner thighs by lunging to the side and holding.

name: Standing Back Rotation Stretch
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend arms at shoulder height or place hands on hips.
Rotate torso gently to one side without moving hips.
Hold stretch for desired time.
Return to center and repeat on other side.
breathingCue: Exhale as you twist, inhale as you return to center.
trainerTip: A standing twisting stretch targeting the obliques and rotational muscles of the back.

name: Standing Bench Calf Stretch
formCues: Feel stretch in calf, not ankle
instructions: Stand in front of a bench or sturdy surface.
Place the ball of one foot onto the edge, keeping heel on the floor.
Lean your body forward while keeping your knee straight.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.
breathingCue: Exhale as you relax into the stretch, inhale as you ease off.
commonMistakes: Letting the foot roll inward or outward
trainerTip: A static stretch using a bench to lengthen the calf muscles.

name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Stand up straight with feet hip-width apart.
Keep knees soft, and hinge forward at the hips.
Lower your torso toward your legs while reaching for your toes.
Stop when you feel a gentle stretch in your hamstrings.
Hold for the desired duration, then return to standing.
breathingCue: Exhale as you hinge forward, inhale as you return upright.
trainerTip: A static stretch targeting the hamstring muscles along the back of the upper leg.

name: Standing Hip Flexor and Abdominal Stretch
instructions: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart.
Lift arms overhead, palms facing forward.
Arch back gently, lifting chest and looking upward.
Shift hips forward slightly to increase hip flexor stretch.
Hold and breathe for desired duration.
breathingCue: Inhale before arching; exhale as you hold the stretch.
